new.title: Eat tas kebab at Sarmaşık Lokantası in Bergama
new.desc: Sarmaşık Lokantası (Köylümün Yeri) is a family-run lokanta in Bergama. Reviewers single out its tas kebab with rice, pan yogurt, fresh salads and bread.
new.tip: Cheap and simple; go at lunch when the daily dishes are fresh. Pair it with a visit to the Pergamon acropolis.
new.q: Sarmaşık Lokantası Köylümün Yeri, Bergama, İzmir

new.title: Dine on fresh fish at Fokai Balık in Eski Foça
new.desc: Fokai Balık is a harbourside fish restaurant in Eski Foça, described by local guides as a fish house since 1984. It sits on 121. Sokak in the Atatürk neighbourhood.
new.tip: Open daily 11:00 to 24:00 per its listing; ask for the day's catch and try the Foça calamari.
new.q: Fokai Balık Restaurant, 121. Sokak, Atatürk Mahallesi, Foça, İzmir

new.title: Order meze at Madam Hestia Meyhanesi above Foça
new.desc: Madam Hestia Meyhanesi is a meyhane in Eski Foça praised for its panoramic view over the old town and harbour. Reviews on the food are mixed but mostly positive.
new.tip: Come for sunset and book a terrace table; the kitchen reportedly closes early, so arrive before 22:00.
new.q: Madam Hestia Meyhanesi, Foça, İzmir

new.title: Eat sea bass at Nena Balık & Meze in Sığacık
new.desc: Nena Balık & Meze Evi is a family-run fish and meze house in the walled harbour village of Sığacık, Seferihisar. Reviewers praise its sea bass and mezes.
new.tip: Opening hours vary by season, so check before going; sit near the castle walls and order sea bass.
new.q: Nena Balık & Meze Evi, Sığacık, Seferihisar, İzmir

new.title: Try sea bass in the courtyard of Milos Balık
new.desc: Milos Balık is a courtyard meyhane on Şadırvan Meydanı in Sığacık, opened in 2013. Reviewers call its sea bass among the best they have eaten.
new.tip: Book a courtyard table on weekend evenings; order the sea bass and a round of cold meze.
new.q: Milos Balık, Şadırvan Meydanı, Sığacık, Seferihisar, İzmir

new.title: Taste Tire şiş köfte at Hacıoğlu Tire Köfte
new.desc: Tire şiş köfte, a thin beef meatball wrapped on a skewer, has had geographical indication status since February 2021. Hacıoğlu Tire Köfte on Mektep Caddesi is one of the köfte shops listed in Tire.
new.tip: Order it with tomato sauce and Tire yogurt; check current hours as listings vary.
new.q: Hacıoğlu Tire Köfte, Mektep Caddesi, Yeni Mahallesi, Tire, İzmir

new.title: Lunch at Birgi Sofrası in the village of Birgi
new.desc: Birgi Sofrası is the restaurant most often recommended for lunch and dinner in the Ottoman-era village of Birgi near Ödemiş. Reviewers mention the Ödemiş köfte.
new.tip: Combine it with a walk through the village lanes; reviews are mixed, so go in daylight and ask for the köfte.
new.q: Birgi Sofrası, Birgi, Ödemiş, İzmir

new.title: Eat Ödemiş köfte at Gürhan Usta
new.desc: Meşhur Ödemiş Köftecisi Gürhan Usta serves the köfte of Ödemiş, traditionally laid on oily bread with roasted pepper and tomato. It is rated 4.8 on Restaurantguru from 557 votes.
new.tip: Go at lunchtime; the köfte come with onion, baked tomato and parsley.
new.q: Meşhur Ödemiş Köftecisi Gürhan Usta, Ödemiş, İzmir

new.title: Grill lunch at Hürşit Kebap in Ödemiş
new.desc: Hürşit Kebap is a kebab restaurant in Ödemiş that Restaurantguru lists at 4.9 from over 5,000 votes, one of the district's most reviewed places.
new.tip: Order the Ödemiş köfte or a kebab portion; busiest at lunch.
new.q: Hürşit Kebap, Ödemiş, İzmir

new.title: Eat köfte at Namlı Köfte Ethem Usta in Menemen
new.desc: Namlı Köfte Ethem Usta is a köfte restaurant in Menemen, listed at 4.7 on Restaurantguru from 770 votes. Menemen district also holds the geographical indication for Menemen menemeni.
new.tip: Pair it with a menemen breakfast earlier in the day; check hours before the trip.
new.q: Namlı Köfte Ethem Usta, Menemen, İzmir

new.title: Try Manisa kebab at Kebapçı Ali in Manisa
new.desc: Kebapçı Ali is named by NTV as one of Manisa's oldest kebab restaurants. Manisa kebab is a beef and lamb mix with onion and sumac, served on pide with butter.
new.tip: Order Manisa kebab with the buttered pide; confirm the address on a map first.
new.q: Kebapçı Ali, Manisa Merkez, Manisa

new.title: Eat Akhisar köfte at Can Köfte
new.desc: Can Köfte is named by Wikivoyage and a Milliyet travel column as one of Akhisar's prominent köfte restaurants. Akhisar köfte is a registered regional product of beef, onion and salt, eaten with pide.
new.tip: Order the köfte with roasted peppers and tomatoes.
new.q: Can Köfte, Akhisar, Manisa

new.title: Eat red mullet at Mimas Balık in Mordoğan
new.desc: Mimas Balık is a seafront fish restaurant at the Mordoğan harbour on the Karaburun peninsula. Red mullet is a local speciality of the harbour restaurants.
new.tip: Listed open 12:00 to 24:00 from May to October; sit by the harbour and ask for the catch.
new.q: Mimas Balık, Mordoğan İskele, Karaburun, İzmir

new.title: Eat fresh fish at Karaburun Balık Evi
new.desc: Karaburun Balık Evi is a fish restaurant in Karaburun town, praised by reviewers for reasonable prices, cleanliness and fresh fish dishes.
new.tip: Go for lunch before the peninsula drive; check hours in winter.
new.q: Karaburun Balık Evi, Karaburun, İzmir

new.title: Join a cooking workshop at Nişanyan Hotel, Şirince
new.desc: The Nişanyan Hotel on a hill above Şirince runs hands-on Turkish cooking workshops of two to three hours using herbs and produce from its own garden. A minimum of four participants is required.
new.tip: Book ahead through the hotel (nisanyan.com); the last stretch of the road is unpaved.
new.q: Nişanyan Hotel, Şirince, Selçuk, İzmir

new.title: Ride through pine forest on the Ephesus Horse Safari
new.desc: Ephesian Tourism runs a four-hour horse safari in the Arvalya area near Selçuk: about 90 minutes in the saddle through pine forest and olive groves, with a stop at the beach.
new.tip: Offered May to September with 12:30 and 17:00 departures; confirm age rules and prices with the company.
new.q: Ephesian Tourism Horse Safari, Arvalya, Selçuk, İzmir

new.title: Taste fruit wines at Solmissos Mahzen in Şirince
new.desc: Solmissos Mahzen is a wine cellar shop in Şirince, the village known for fruit wines, praised for its wines, friendly staff and decor.
new.tip: Ask for tastings of different fruits such as pomegranate or blackberry; the shop sells bottles to take home.
new.q: Solmissos Mahzen, Şirince, Selçuk, İzmir

new.title: Sample fruit wine at Papazın Mahzeni Şarap Evi
new.desc: Şirince Papazın Mahzeni Şarap Evi is described as a charming wine-tasting shop on the way into Şirince, where fruit wines are offered for tasting and sale.
new.tip: Tasting usually starts with the fruit of your choice; a traditional grape red is poured on request.
new.q: Şirince Papazın Mahzeni Şarap Evi, Şirince, Selçuk, İzmir

new.title: Hike the Şirince village and vineyard loop
new.desc: A listed Komoot loop of about 6.5 km and roughly two hours with 250 m of climbing starts near Şirince and passes traditional villages and vineyards. Şirince lies about 8 km east of Selçuk.
new.tip: Spring and autumn are best for hiking in İzmir province; carry water and download the route first.
new.q: Şirince Köyü, Selçuk, İzmir

new.title: Eat fish and meze at Clup Ali meyhane in Alsancak
new.desc: Clup Ali is an Alsancak meyhane known for seafood and rakı, at 1469 Sokak No:35. It is open evenings daily.
new.tip: Reserve at weekends; order sea bass and a meze spread.
new.q: Clup Ali, 1469 Sokak No:35, Alsancak, Konak, İzmir

new.title: Spend an evening at Endülüs Meyhane in Alsancak
new.desc: Endülüs Meyhane is an Alsancak meyhane that mixes traditional tavern culture with live music.
new.tip: Come in the evening; expect music and book ahead on weekends.
new.q: Endülüs Meyhane, Alsancak, Konak, İzmir

new.title: Queue for an İzmir bomba at Çelebi Unlu Mamüller
new.desc: Çelebi Unlu Mamüller in Alsancak is named as the best-known address for the İzmir bomba, a filled fried dessert, and usually has a queue.
new.tip: Eat it warm; the line moves quickly.
new.q: Çelebi Unlu Mamüller, Alsancak, Konak, İzmir

new.title: Eat künefe at Künefeci Sergen Usta in Karşıyaka
new.desc: Künefeci Sergen Usta in Atakent, Karşıyaka, serves several künefe varieties including the Yeşilsultan and Peynirli Paşa, plus ice cream items.
new.tip: Shared trays carry a deposit; order cheese künefe hot.
new.q: Künefeci Sergen Usta, Atakent, Karşıyaka, İzmir

new.title: Have pastry at Reyhan Pastanesi in Bostanlı
new.desc: Reyhan Pastanesi in Bostanlı, Karşıyaka, is rated 9.1 on a Foursquare list of İzmir pastry and café venues.
new.tip: Pair it with a stroll along the Bostanlı waterfront.
new.q: Reyhan Pastanesi, Bostanlı, Karşıyaka, İzmir
